### LMM with a GRM with everyone and group category as a fixed effect  ---

```{r}
meta <- readRDS("/filepath/meta_data.rds")
exp <- readRDS("/filepath/exp.rds")
K <- readRDS("/filepath/K.rds")
```

make sure everything is in the same order
```{r}
identical(meta$sample_name,colnames(exp))
identical(meta$sample_name,colnames(K))
identical(colnames(exp),colnames(K))
```

make sure everything is in the same order
```{r}
identical(meta$sample_name,colnames(exp))
identical(meta$sample_name,colnames(K))
identical(colnames(exp),colnames(K))
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
#ensure group is a factor 
meta$ancestry_groups = as.factor(meta$ancestry_groups)
meta$ancestry_groups <- relevel(meta$ancestry_groups, ref = "Senoi")

modSv = model.matrix(~urb_scale + early_scale + age_scale + sex_medical + ancestry_groups, data=meta)

Z <- matrix(0, nrow = length(rownames(K)), ncol = length(colnames(K)))
rownames(Z) <- rownames(K)
colnames(Z) <- colnames(K)

for (i in seq_along(rownames(Z))) {
  match_idx <- match(rownames(Z)[i], meta$sample_name)
  if (!is.na(match_idx)) {
    Z[i, match_idx] <- 1
  }
}

#Declare object res_full to store in it the model results: beta coefficients, standard deviations and p values
res_full = matrix(NA, nrow=nrow(exp), ncol=3 * ncol(modSv))
colnames(res_full) = c(
  paste0("beta_", colnames(modSv)),
  paste0("sdev_", colnames(modSv)),
  paste0("p_value_", colnames(modSv))
)
res_full = as.data.frame(res_full)
rownames(res_full)=rownames(exp)

#run the model and store results (need to run in console)
for(i in 1:nrow(exp))
{
  emma=emmreml(y=exp[i,],X=modSv,Z=as.matrix(Z),K=as.matrix(K),varbetahat=T,varuhat=T,PEVuhat=T,test=T)
  res_full[i,]=t(c(emma$betahat,emma$varbetahat,emma$pvalbeta[,"none"]))
  print(i)
}

#save res_full
#saveRDS(res_full,file='/filepath/lmm_grm_evryne_grp_fixed_effect_26nov25.rds')
```

### elastic net regression  ---


training data
```{r}
stable_idx <- meta %>% filter(lifestyle_bins %in% c("always_rural", "always_urban")) %>% dplyr::select(sample_name)
X <- exp[, stable_idx$sample_name]
X <- t(X) 
y <- factor(meta$lifestyle_bins[match(rownames(X), meta$sample_name)], levels = c("always_rural", "always_urban"))
y_bin <- ifelse(y == "always_urban", 1, 0)
```

```{r}
pred <- rep(NA, length(y_bin))

for (i in seq_along(y_bin)) {

  X_train <- X[-i, ]
  y_train <- y_bin[-i]

  X_test <- X[i, , drop = FALSE]

  cvfit <- cv.glmnet(x = X_train, y = y_train, family = "binomial", alpha = 1, nfolds = 50)

  pred[i] <- predict(cvfit, newx = X_test, s = "lambda.min", type = "response")
  
  print(i)
}
```

look at how well it predicts with the leave one out 
```{r}
roc_obj <- roc(y_bin, pred)
auc(roc_obj)
```

```{r}
final_fit <- cv.glmnet(x = X, y = y_bin, family = "binomial", alpha = 1, nfolds = 50)

switch_idx = meta %>% filter(lifestyle_bins %in% c("rural_to_urban", "urban_to_rural")) %>% dplyr::select(sample_name)
X_switch <- t(exp[, switch_idx$sample_name])   # transpose: samples × genes

# Predict urbanicity probability for switchers
switch_scores <- predict(final_fit, newx = X_switch, s = "lambda.min", type = "response")
```
